dedupe_keys.name: efficient discovery of emerging patterns in heterogeneous spatiotemporal data from mobile sensors

description: E 2 PAT implements time differencing and spatial intersection to identify emerging patterns in heterogeneous fixed/mobile sensor observations. The study evaluates the method on Lisbon geolocated road speeds and loop counts, with a relevance score for retrieving patterns. Its stated linear scaling is a source-reported algorithmic property, not a benchmark reproduced here. The older emerging-patterns repository now redirects to e 2 pat. The catalogue relates that same software to the thesis and conference publication, while biclustering remains a separate analytical method. GNU General Public terms are stated without a version and are not recognised by current GitHub licence metadata. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label not stated. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened. The source establishes traffic-pattern analysis; a separate network-flow solver or forecast use is not asserted.
